$comment: Single source of truth for the game's settings (hwaoi.ini next to the game). Used by the launcher's settings pages, by tools/release.py to write recomplauncher.json `settings`, and for docs/SETTINGS.md. Keys are the runtime's (runtime/cfg.c metas[]) in lower case, as the runtime writes them. `section` is the INI section the runtime files the key under (cfg.c section_of). kind: choice | toggle | slider | dynamic. `restart`: the running game only picks it up on the next start.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 1080p is the tested baseline; 1440p and 4K are experimental (menus and movies may not scale yet).

settings.label: Fullscreen
settings.help: Fill the screen. F11 switches it while you play.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size of the window when not in fullscreen.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 60 is the game's own speed. 30 saves power. 90 and 120 also speed the game up (gameplay advances one step per frame): for smoother motion keep 60 and use frame generation.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Mailbox shows the newest frame without tearing. V-Sync waits for the screen. Immediate has the lowest latency but can tear.

settings.label: 3D resolution
settings.help: Native draws the 3D scene at the full resolution. Dynamic lets the game lower it in busy scenes, as on the console.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to your screen. AMD FSR keeps it sharp on any graphics card.

settings.label: Sharpness
settings.help: FSR sharpening. 0 is soft, 100 is crisp.

settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.help: Keep 16:9 adds borders on other screens. Stretch fills them.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.help: Camera field of view compared with the console (100 %).

settings.label: Performance overlay
settings.help: Frame rate and timings in a corner of the game. F10 cycles it while you play.

settings.label: Graphics card
settings.help: Which graphics card runs the game. Automatic picks the fastest.

settings.label: Device profile
settings.help: Steam Deck uses lighter defaults for handheld PCs.

settings.label: Colour
settings.help: Game's own colours, a more vivid look, extra clarity, or your own values below.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: Lighter or darker picture.

settings.label: Contrast
settings.help: Difference between light and dark.

settings.label: Saturation
settings.help: Colour strength.

settings.label: Gamma
settings.help: Mid-tone brightness.

settings.label: Game language
settings.help: The language of the game's text and voices menu. Automatic follows your system.

settings.label: In-game menu language
settings.help: The language of the settings menu you open with Esc, and of the overlay. Automatic follows your system.

settings.label: Console mode
settings.help: Docked is the TV mode. Handheld uses the console's portable settings, lighter on slower PCs.

settings.label: Keep running in the background
settings.help: Off pauses the game when you switch to another window.

settings.label: Master volume
settings.help: Above 100 % boosts quiet speakers.

settings.label: Player 1
settings.help: Automatic takes the first controller, or the keyboard and mouse.

settings.label: Player 1 controller
settings.help: What the game sees: one Pro Controller, or a pair of Joy-Con.

settings.label: Player 2
settings.help: The second player in co-op. None turns co-op input off.

settings.label: Player 2 controller
settings.help: What the game sees for player 2.

settings.label: Button layout
settings.help: Nintendo keeps A on the right. Xbox puts A at the bottom. Xbox labels makes the button marked A confirm on any pad.

settings.label: Stick dead zone
settings.help: Raise it if the camera or character drifts on its own.

settings.label: Motion controls
settings.help: Gyro and accelerometer from controllers that have them (Switch, Switch 2, DualSense, DualShock 4).

settings.label: Rumble strength
settings.help: 0 turns rumble off.

settings.label: Rumble curve
settings.help: Lower values make light rumble stronger; 1 is linear.

settings.label: Trigger rumble
settings.help: Impulse triggers on Xbox One and Series controllers.

settings.label: Mouse sensitivity
settings.help: Camera speed with the mouse.

settings.label: Asynchronous GPU replay
settings.help: Experimental: about 15 % more FPS in tests, not yet checked in every scene.

settings.label: Thread preemption
settings.help: How the game's threads share your CPU. Leave on unless told otherwise.

settings.label: Leave cores free
settings.help: Keeps some CPU cores free for streaming or recording.

settings.label: Precise timer
settings.help: 1 ms system timer for steadier frame pacing.

settings.label: Memory on demand
settings.help: Windows: commit game memory only when used. Helps PCs with 16 GB of RAM. Automatic turns it on when memory is short.

settings.label: Small memory pools
settings.help: Smaller GPU upload blocks: less RAM, same speed.

settings.label: Compress shader sources
settings.help: Saves about 160 MB of RAM.

settings.label: Prepare shaders early
settings.help: Builds pipelines in the background to reduce stutter.

settings.label: Translate compute shaders early
settings.help: Less stutter the first time an effect appears.

settings.label: Texture decoding
settings.help: Where the game's compressed textures are decoded.

settings.label: VRAM budget
settings.help: How much of your graphics memory textures may use before older ones are released.

settings.label: Vulkan validation
settings.help: For bug reports only: much slower. Needs the Vulkan SDK.

settings.label: Flight recorder
settings.help: Records timing spikes into the log for bug reports.
